verdict.rationale: Make publishes a structured REST API reference with per-endpoint pages covering connections, data stores, analytics, audit logs and AI agents, plus authentication guides and an llms.txt index. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive 'try it' console or runnable examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: interactive in-browser request execution, runnable code examples, a public OpenAPI/Swagger spec, hands-on corroboration.
